Fajita Steak Loaded Sweet Potato Nachos

by @hannahmuch · See original

Method

01Roast the sweet potato rounds at 425°F until the edges caramelise and crisp.
02Sear the steak hard, two minutes a side. Rest it before slicing against the grain.
03Char the peppers and onion in the same pan with the rest of the fajita spice.
04Layer it over the rounds. Finish with guac, soured cream and coriander.
